$comment: The Antigravity models `agy` lists for this account, each with the levels `agy` accepts for `--effort` (null: the model takes no effort). `models` are the ones the window's pickers offer; `left_out` are the ones Switchboard leaves out on purpose, each with its reason. agentSelection.ts reads both: the pickers offer `models`, and an agent or saved quick choice already on a left-out model keeps its label and its correct effort levels. live_antigravity_model_table_matches_the_cli_model_list (desktop/src-tauri/src/antigravity_models.rs) compares the two lists together with `agy --output-format json models`, so a model Google adds, retires or re-levels fails `make test-live-antigravity`. A model `agy` does not list can be in neither list; harness-behavior.md §3.3 records why Gemini 4 Carbon is absent. The list is the signed-in account's (Business and Google Cloud sign-ins can hide models), so before deleting a model the test reports missing, confirm it is gone: dispatch it bare, `agy -p ack --model <id>` without `--effort`, which reports `not recognized as a known model` (with `--effort` agy misreports an unknown model as `--effort is not supported`), or check from a second account. Matches agy 1.5.12 (2026-11-19), where both offered models dispatched at every listed level.

left_out.label: Gemini 4 Argon
left_out.reason: Gemini 4 Neon is its stronger successor.

left_out.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
left_out.reason: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4's fast, cheap model, does its job better.

left_out.label: Claude Opus 5.5
left_out.reason: Claude models run better as Claude Code agents, which Switchboard can fork, compact and pin.

left_out.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
left_out.reason: Claude models run better as Claude Code agents, which Switchboard can fork, compact and pin.

left_out.label: GPT-OSS 120B
left_out.reason: The picker offers only Gemini 4 Neon and Hydrogen, and Hydrogen covers fast, cheap work.

left_out.label: Orchestrator (Neon)
left_out.reason: It takes no effort level, so it does not fit the picker's model-plus-effort shape.

left_out.label: Orchestrator (Argon)
left_out.reason: It takes no effort level, so it does not fit the picker's model-plus-effort shape.
